page.layout: One page of verse, one column, set in the centre. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. No notes, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.p: Quas dederit Stelico, q[?]nas & Rufinus & ille Bærbarica Imperium inuasit qui fraude Gainas Dum patria gemimus casum fatumque ruentis Et nostrum, nec iam superest spes vlla salutis Fulmina ceu cœlo ruere insperata sereno, Dissicere & summas arces & tecta videmus Improuisus ades: nec te peccata morantur Nostra sed irarum fluctus effundis in hostem Ergo iacet calidoque dedit tibi sanguine pœnas, Quámque virum cæde infecit terram ore momordit. Quid memorem scelerum socios, penéque repente Demissos orco Iuuenes? vtque agmine longo Has illásque vias incerto errore retexant Coniuratorum fugientes iusta caterua Supplicia? vt pedibus celeres timor addidit alas? Sic qui nos nuper iussere excedere regno Diffugiunt, nullisque audent se credere terris Terrore exanimes, furiarum & verbere surdo. O cœcas hominum mentes! o nescia corda Venturi! spes o fragiles & innania vota! Nempe hic iam regno, si fas & Rege subacto Imperium terris animos æquabat Olympo Cumque suis domitas, erciscere cœperat oras Interea cæcum voluebat corde dolorem Henricus, sceptro Gallos qui fleċtit auito Vulnus alens venis, manet alta mente repostum Inque suum caput, inque suos, regnique quietem Consilium externique hostes ad busta vocati Et prædam

page.notes: The first word is printed as "qnas"; the q carries a stroke, read as quas, so marked [?]. "Bærbarica" shows an æ-like ligature after the B; marked [?]. The line "Improuisus ades: nec" has no space after the colon in print; kept as printed. Long s is printed as s and is transcribed as plain s. Scan ends at "Et prædam"; the sense continues on a following page.
